[[Nicholas the Traveler]] | render = [[File:Demonic Relic.jpg|150px]] }} '''Bone Charms''' are worn by the [[Outcast]]s. ==Acquisition== * [[The Jade Sea]] ** [[Outcast Assassin]] ** [[Outcast Deathhand]] ** [[Outcast Ritualist]] ** [[Outcast Warrior]] {{ongoing item research}} ===Farming=== ====Rhea's Crater==== From [[Seafarer's Rest]], enter [[Rhea's Crater]] and head northeast. A group of around 20 Outcasts can be found. They are easily body blocked and balled due to the winding staircase. The rest of Rhea's Crater also has lots of large groups of Outcasts, many on the path that leads to Nicholas. ====Gyala Hatchery==== Enter [[Gyala Hatchery (explorable area)|Gyala Hatchery]] from [[Leviathan Pits]]. There are 3 groups of Outcasts on the way to Rhea's Crater. Hurry, these groups are under attack. ==Collectors== {{:Jefri Whylir/Collector}} {{:Nicholas the Traveler/Collector|15th February 2010 and 2nd April 2012|Rhea's Crater|3 [[Bone Charm (trophy)|Bone Charms]]}} [[Category:Contains bone]]
